answer: Commit the receipt, reveal after the epoch closes, then compare reveals across peers. Dilute the reward by the number of disagreeing peers, so a contested answer pays a fraction. Vest the remainder against future work. Assume the attacker reads the mempool: it will front-run a reveal, which is why the commitment binds the author key and the epoch together. The tide of a replayed receipt shows as an identical echo in two reveals. Cost: one commitment per answer, one bond per key, and 20 epochs before the orchard pays anything.
